result.title: Gate3DGen: A Pre-processing Model that Selectively Purifies Real-World Images for 3D Generation
result.summary: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. Purifying such inputs requires deciding when to intervene and preserving the visual cues needed for 3D generation, while leaving clean inputs unchanged. We introduce Gate3DGen, a selective pre-processing model that gates image inputs to existing 3D generators without retraining them. A degradation-aware router bypasses inputs classified as clean and extracts features to guide purification of the remaining inputs. Conditioned on these features, a 3D-oriented one-step purifier purifies degraded inputs with spatial losses that encourage preservation of object identity, contours, and textural cues. To provide paired supervision, we construct a synthetic data engine that renders clean views of 3D assets and synthesises composite degradations. On the synthetic benchmark, the purifier improves image fidelity and downstream 3D geometry in only 2.3s on average, reducing TRELLIS.2 mesh distance by 61.5% relative to degraded inputs. VLM evaluation and human preferences on real photographs further support identity preservation and degradation correction. More demos and code are available at https://supra-3d.github.io/gate3dgen.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Gate3DGen：用退化感知路由器判断输入图像是否干净、干净图像直接旁路，其余交由单步净化器配合保留身份、轮廓与纹理线索的空间损失处理，为现成 3D 生成器提供前处理。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时介入」的门控路由与视觉线索保留损失，可能可供核查 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 STOP 决策；但该工作处于像素域 3D 生成前处理，不涉及 latent 推理状态，迁移性需自行判断。
